fields.title: How to Stay Hydrated
fields.content: Drinking enough water is essential for your overall health. Aim for at least 8 glasses a day. Remember to increase your intake during hot weather or physical activity.

fields.name: Severe Chest Pain
fields.description: Intense pain in the chest area.
fields.emergency_message: Severe chest pain can be a sign of a heart attack. Call emergency services immediately

fields.name: Severe chest pain
fields.description: Intense pain or pressure in the chest, possibly radiating to arms, neck, or jaw.
fields.emergency_message: Severe chest pain can indicate a heart attack or other life-threatening condition. Call emergency services immediately.

fields.name: Sudden severe headache
fields.description: An extremely intense headache that appears suddenly, often described as the worst headache of my life.
fields.emergency_message: A sudden severe headache could indicate a stroke or brain hemorrhage. Seek emergency medical care immediately.

fields.name: Severe difficulty breathing
fields.description: Inability to breathe properly, gasping for air, or feeling of suffocation.
fields.emergency_message: Severe difficulty breathing is a medical emergency. Call emergency services or go to the nearest hospital immediately.

fields.name: Loss of consciousness
fields.description: Fainting or complete loss of awareness.
fields.emergency_message: Loss of consciousness requires immediate emergency medical attention. Call emergency services.

fields.name: Severe uncontrolled bleeding
fields.description: Heavy bleeding that does not stop with direct pressure.
fields.emergency_message: Uncontrolled bleeding is a medical emergency. Apply direct pressure and seek emergency care immediately.

fields.name: Thoughts of self-harm
fields.description: Thoughts of hurting oneself or ending ones life.
fields.emergency_message: If you are having thoughts of self-harm, please reach out for help immediately. Contact a crisis helpline or go to the nearest emergency room.

fields.name: Sudden confusion or disorientation
fields.description: Abrupt inability to think clearly, recognize people or places, or speak coherently.
fields.emergency_message: Sudden confusion may indicate a stroke or other serious neurological emergency. Seek immediate medical care.

fields.name: High fever with stiff neck
fields.description: High temperature combined with inability to bend the neck forward.
fields.emergency_message: High fever with a stiff neck may indicate meningitis. Seek emergency medical care immediately.

fields.name: Seizures
fields.description: Uncontrolled electrical disturbance in the brain causing changes in behavior, movements, or consciousness.
fields.emergency_message: Seizures require immediate medical attention. If this is a first-time seizure or lasts more than 5 minutes, call emergency services.

fields.name: Severe abdominal pain
fields.description: Intense pain in the abdomen that is sudden and severe.
fields.emergency_message: Severe abdominal pain may indicate a surgical emergency such as appendicitis. Seek immediate medical care.

fields.name: Measles

fields.name: Chronic Kidney Disease

fields.name: Coronary Artery Disease

fields.name: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
